yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-logburst
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: burst
      run: |
        echo burst-begin
        sleep 8
        for i in $(seq 1 2000); do echo "burst-$i"; done
        sleep 30
        echo burst-end
